name: neptune-graph
description: Neptune Analytics is a new analytics database engine for Amazon Neptune that helps customers get to insights faster by quickly processing large amounts of graph data, invoking popular graph analytic algorithms in low-latency queries, and getting analytics results in seconds.

subcommands.name: cancel-export-task
subcommands.description: Cancel the specified export task.

subcommands.name: cancel-import-task
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified import task.

subcommands.name: cancel-query
subcommands.description: Cancels a specified query.

subcommands.name: create-graph
subcommands.description: Creates a new Neptune Analytics graph.

subcommands.name: create-graph-snapshot
subcommands.description: Creates a snapshot of the specific graph.

subcommands.name: create-graph-using-import-task
subcommands.description: Creates a new Neptune Analytics graph and imports data into it, either from Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) or from a Neptune database or a Neptune database snapshot.

subcommands.name: create-private-graph-endpoint
subcommands.description: Create a private graph endpoint to allow private access to the graph from within a VPC.

subcommands.name: delete-graph
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified graph.

subcommands.name: delete-graph-snapshot
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified graph snapshot.

subcommands.name: delete-private-graph-endpoint
subcommands.description: Deletes a private graph endpoint.

subcommands.name: execute-query
subcommands.description: Execute an openCypher query.

subcommands.name: get-export-task
subcommands.description: Retrieves a specified export task.

subcommands.name: get-graph
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified graph.

subcommands.name: get-graph-snapshot
subcommands.description: Retrieves a specified graph snapshot.

subcommands.name: get-graph-summary
subcommands.description: Gets a graph summary for a property graph.

subcommands.name: get-import-task
subcommands.description: Retrieves a specified import task.

subcommands.name: get-private-graph-endpoint
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a specified private endpoint.

subcommands.name: get-query
subcommands.description: Retrieves the status of a specified query.

subcommands.name: list-export-tasks
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of export tasks.

subcommands.name: list-graph-snapshots
subcommands.description: Lists available snapshots of a specified Neptune Analytics graph.

subcommands.name: list-graphs
subcommands.description: Lists available Neptune Analytics graphs.

subcommands.name: list-import-tasks
subcommands.description: Lists import tasks.

subcommands.name: list-private-graph-endpoints
subcommands.description: Lists private endpoints for a specified Neptune Analytics graph.

subcommands.name: list-queries
subcommands.description: Lists active openCypher queries.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists tags associated with a specified resource.

subcommands.name: reset-graph
subcommands.description: Empties the data from a specified Neptune Analytics graph.

subcommands.name: restore-graph-from-snapshot
subcommands.description: Restores a graph from a snapshot.

subcommands.name: start-export-task
subcommands.description: Export data from an existing Neptune Analytics graph to Amazon S3.

subcommands.name: start-graph
subcommands.description: Starts the specific graph.

subcommands.name: start-import-task
subcommands.description: Import data into existing Neptune Analytics graph from Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3).

subcommands.name: stop-graph
subcommands.description: Stops the specific graph.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds tags to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-graph
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of a specified Neptune Analytics graph

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: export-task-cancelled
subcommands.description: Wait until Export Task is Cancelled It will poll every 60 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: export-task-successful
subcommands.description: Wait until Export Task is Successful It will poll every 60 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: graph-available
subcommands.description: Wait until Graph is Available It will poll every 60 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: graph-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until Graph is Deleted It will poll every 60 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: graph-snapshot-available
subcommands.description: Wait until GraphSnapshot is Available It will poll every 60 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: graph-snapshot-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until GraphSnapshot is Deleted It will poll every 60 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: graph-stopped
subcommands.description: Wait until Graph is Stopped It will poll every 20 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: import-task-cancelled
subcommands.description: Wait until Import Task is Cancelled It will poll every 60 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: import-task-successful
subcommands.description: Wait until Import Task is Successful It will poll every 60 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: private-graph-endpoint-available
subcommands.description: Wait until PrivateGraphEndpoint is Available It will poll every 10 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: private-graph-endpoint-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until PrivateGraphEndpoint is Deleted It will poll every 10 seconds until a successful state has been reached.
